title: Chapter 192 Can’T Go Back
content:
Chapter 192 Can’T Go Back

"Heifu, I never expected that it was you who saved us. Otherwise, we would all be Chu captives, and I'm afraid we wouldn't be able to go back in this life!"

When Zhou Hua came over, he punched Heifu excitedly, but forgot that his own hand had just been injured. He immediately squatted on the ground in pain, but still had a smile on his face and said: "Speaking of which, you also You are so brave, you actually went to the Chu people in person to pretend to surrender. Hey, it was really fun just now. Those Chu people who humiliated me were all killed by me, everyone, stones, and weapons!"

Hei Fu pulled him up and said, "General Zhou Bai has suffered a lot. If you hadn't waited behind to hold back the Chu army's hundreds of people, this battle wouldn't have been so smooth. I wonder how many casualties there were among the people in the pit?"

It's okay not to mention it. When talking about this, Zhou Hua's face turned gloomy: "We are bare-handed, our armor has been peeled off, and we are hungry and tired. Although the three hundred people fought back hard, at least hundreds of them died or were seriously injured. …”

"what a pity."

Heifu also sighed and glanced around. Bodies were spread all over the outskirts of the city, including those from his own side and those from the enemy. The number had not yet been counted. The Chu people who were fleeing in all directions had become small black spots, and the Qin people had no desire to pursue them, because Dou Ran had been captured, and the Chu people were leaderless, and they were not afraid of them regaining their strength and fighting back.

What we should do now is to quickly pack up the captured chariots and horses, count the casualties, and quickly protect Li You and continue running...

At this time, Dongmen Leopard came over, with an impatient look on his face. With just one sentence, Heifu's excitement about winning the battle for the first time under his command and capturing a county magistrate from the state of Chu was offset.

"General Bai, Huaimu is seriously injured. I'm afraid he may die. Please go over and have a look!"

…

The trapped soldiers were the first to join the battlefield, with the important task of attacking the enemy array and disrupting it. Originally, Heifu and Huaimu said that they could retreat when the main force also rushed in, but once the fight started, how could they say Just withdraw? Throughout the battle, there were always those trapped in the team, so they suffered the most casualties.

Many people were found among the dead. A fellow Qin soldier who had followed Heifu since he left Anlu County fell in a pool of blood that was gradually solidifying. His eyes were wide open, his body was injured several times, and he was lying beside him. Ji Yingzheng led people to separate several Chu people who died with him. The Qin soldiers moved aside, while the Chu people were left to the crow.

Heifu didn't stop. He followed Dongmen Leopard and hurried to a small tree. He saw Sophora japonica leaning against the tree, just like when Heifu saw him for the first time at the head of Waihuang City. The village chief closed his eyes quietly and looked pale. Only the rising and falling of his chest let him know that he was still alive.

"Huaimu...you..."

Heifu's eyes were about to burst. He saw that a broken spear was deeply pierced into Huaimu's abdomen, and there were two arrows that were pierced into his thigh and chest, leaving only their feathers.

His left hand, which Heifu had bandaged for him personally, was missing from the elbow down!

Huaimu opened his eyes, saw Heifu kneeling on one knee in front of him, and smiled.

"Heifu, I'm afraid you won't be able to stop the bleeding this time..."

"Don't talk, maybe you can still..." Heifu regretted it so much. At this moment, he only wished that he had ordered Sophora japonica to be the camp leader who trapped the team.

"We, can we win?"

Huaimu tilted his head and asked weakly.

"Won!"

Heifu excitedly said to him: "A great victory! The Chu general was captured and the Chu people fled in embarrassment. It's all thanks to you and the soldiers who trapped him. You have to hold on. When you return to the country, you will naturally have something to lose." Rewards for great achievements!"

As Hei Fu said this, he asked someone to pull the Chu people's flag over. He just wanted to cover Huai Mu's wound, but his injury was too deep and heavy. The blood soaked the silk flag, but he couldn't stop it...

"That's all."

Huaimu chuckled and said, "I was still thinking that if I win this battle, in more than a month, I will be able to sit at the village festival, hold my wife in my arms, brag to my two brothers about my bravery on the battlefield, and to my hometown. Party members show off their scars..."

"But now it seems that I'm afraid I can't do it!"

He coughed violently and spit out blood.

"Heifu, can you do one thing for me..."

"Say!" Heifu held his remaining hand tightly, feeling increasingly cold.

"Go to Jingling County for me to see if my two younger brothers have been redeemed from vassals and become common people? Then, for me, tell my wife who has just been married a few months..."

"What did you say?" Huaimu's voice became smaller and smaller, and Heifu could only put his ear to his mouth.

"Let's just say...Huaimu broke his promise."

"Sophora wood can't go back."

"This is the first time Huaimu has broken his promise."

"It's also the last time..."

"Let her not wait any longer, find someone in the countryside and get married again!"

Heifu felt that his throat was choked and stiff, and he couldn't say anything, so he could only nod his head.

After saying that, Huaimu seemed to be relieved. His eyes began to blur, began to turn black, and he began to see the people around him clearly. He could only subconsciously extend his right hand to the distant sky, as if he wanted to, before he died, Touch something again, grab something again, maybe it's my wife's warm hands, maybe it's my brothers' fluffy buns.

Even the hilt of the sword he was most familiar with.

The winter sky in Huaibei is filled with white clouds and the sunshine is soft, but Sophora japonica is feeling cold.

"I really want to go home..." He smiled and sighed with regret.

…

Captain Li You groaned and opened his eyes, finding that the afternoon sunlight came in from outside and stung his eyes.

"Captain?"

There was a shadow standing next to the couch. He was ordered by Hei Fu to stay and take care of Li You's fortune teller. This diviner was a folk herbalist. When Li You had a fever, he found some herbs in the city and prepared them for Li You. After drinking it, Heifu was acting like a living doctor at that time. He never thought that Li You's fever had really gone away!

"How long has it been since I fell asleep?"

Li You looked at his chest wrapped in cloth. The wound was still painful, but it had reduced a lot, especially the burning sensation that had disappeared. He had not slept well this night. Not only was he physically uncomfortable, but he was also always in pain. I felt like someone was calling me, and something big seemed to have happened outside.

"It's been four hours." Bu Cheng had been looking at the sun outside by the window to calculate the time, and immediately picked up the bamboo tube and brought it to his lips.

"This is..." Li You thought it was still the bitter medicine soup that was difficult to swallow.

"It's just water."

So Li You drank. His lips were chapped, and the warm water was as sweet as honey. Then Bu Cheng gave him some gruel to drink. Li You felt that he had regained a little strength and could at least speak and think.

"What happened when I fell asleep? Heifu went to pretend to surrender, what happened?" He finally cleared his mind and asked hurriedly.

Bu Cheng bowed down and said, "I dare to tell you to the captain that in the morning, Xu Yang, a hundred generals, rebelled and tried to kidnap the captain to escape. They have been put down. He and thirty of his men have been beheaded by the military judge!"

"What!"

Li You was shocked. Heifu, the fake five hundred leader he had designated when he was unconscious, was not in the city, and internal strife broke out again. This was not a big deal. Did all the Chu people take the opportunity to attack?

"That's not true. After Xu Yang waited for the rebellion to be put down, hundreds of generals also came back. He was in the city half an hour ago to motivate the soldiers, and two moments ago he went out to attack the enemy..."

Bu Cheng was actually restless, so he paused and said, "But I don't know what the outcome will be. It's just that the deafening shouts of killing just now have stopped..."

"I see."

Li You felt that his mind was confused, and the doubts in his heart were getting deeper and deeper. He was a man of his own opinions and did not believe in the one-sided words of divination. Xu Yang is his old subordinate. Although his abilities are limited, he won't do such crazy things, right? Could it be that there is some hidden secret in this matter?

But none of this mattered anymore, because the scheduled battle had already started and even ended. Li You didn't know whether the Qin people could still work together after experiencing an internal strife, and whether the previously expected breakout could be realized?

There may be three possibilities. First, the Qin people completely defeated the Chu people and the plan was a perfect success. Secondly, the Qin people just barely opened a way, and Heifu would break through with the remaining people, leaving Li You in the city. The three Qin people were defeated, and the Chu people entered the city...

If it is the second or third kind, then Li You will be completely finished. Not only his life, but also his father's career will be greatly affected. The son of Qin Guoting Wei Li Si was defeated and captured... What a shame.

Li You even began to think about how to commit suicide. His father was trusted by the King of Qin and he would definitely be the prime minister in the future. As his son, he must not implicate him!

"Father, if you really can't go back, you will never survive..."

However, while they were talking, heavy footsteps were heard outside...

"coming."

Bu Cheng stood up excitedly, and Li You also looked at the door, but they didn't know whether the people coming were Chu people or Qin people?

Li You was shocked. He wanted to sit up and get the sword, but he felt as weak as a sick raccoon. He didn't even have the strength to commit suicide. He could only lie on the couch in a daze, waiting for the judgment of fate.

The door was pushed open, and a dark figure walked into the room, his armor clattering. He knelt on the ground, cupped his hands towards Li You and said, "My servant, Heifu, pay my respects to Captain Li!"

Heifu's body still smells of blood, and his eyes are red. Perhaps he was blinded by the winter sand...

"Excuse me, how is the battle going?" Seeing that it was Hei Fu, Li You looked happy, turned sideways and asked with Bu Cheng's support.

"Thanks to the captain, the Chu people are defeated, our army is victorious, the siege has been lifted, and you can leave here at any time!"

"Good, great good!"

Li You breathed a long sigh of relief. It seemed that he had made the right choice by choosing Hei Fu to be the fake master of 500!

In this way, Xu Yang's death became irrelevant. Li You didn't even mention it and directly asked about the result of the battle.

Time was running out, so Heifu briefly reported the military judge's count.

Although this battle was won with a single charge and was short-lived, there were many casualties due to the fierce fighting. The 700 Qin people who followed Heifu into the Chu formation suffered nearly 200 casualties. Especially the 100 trapped soldiers, including the commander of the camp, Huaimu, were almost half damaged and could never return to their hometown. Of the three hundred Qin prisoners, one hundred were killed and seriously injured.

About four hundred Chu people died, and a hundred more were taken prisoner. The rest fled in all directions, including those from the south, south, north, and south. It is worth mentioning that there were more than ten chariots trapped in the formation, abandoned by the Chu people, and became the trophies of the Qin army!

"With these horses and chariots, we can also take away the lightly wounded soldiers!" Heifu said.

This was not what Li You was most concerned about. He asked: "You just said that you captured Hu Gong Dou Ran of the Chu State alive. Did you capture the flag of the Chu army?"

"Except for Gongsun Feng's flag, which was not obtained, the other flags include one flag for Hu Gong Dou Ran, one flag for thousands of soldiers, and seven flags for hundreds of soldiers..."

"Okay! The flags are also a credit. With them as evidence, the number of beheadings this time can be believed by the domestic law officials!"

Li You was very happy. There is a military law that says: There are flags from Wei Shi down, and those who win the flags in victory will each be regarded as the title they get, and they will be rewarded and persuaded clearly.

The number of beheadings in this battle can even reach seven or eight hundred! Of course he understood that it was impossible and he had no time to take the beheaded people back and count them, so he could only ask the military judge to count them and then hand over the captured military flags as proof.

In addition to capturing enemy generals, seizing military flags, and beheading four to five hundred levels, there was also the achievement of rescuing other troops. As the saying goes, "If the officer in front abandons his soldiers and heads north, the officers in the back can kill them, and those who capture their soldiers will be rewarded." It means that if the general in the front abandons his troops and runs away, the generals in the rear can kill him and take his troops. Those who are kept together will be rewarded.

Li You secretly counted these achievements and looked at Heifu again. He was appreciative in his heart, but also a little regretful and even envious, because if these achievements could be attributed to him as the general, they would at least offset the previous achievements in Xiangcheng. For the crime of overthrowing the army and defeating the enemy, not only does it not require a reduction in rank, but it can even be upgraded by one level!

But this battle was not fought by him after all. From pretending to surrender to winning troops and then commanding to defeat the enemy, it was all performed by Heifu alone. During this period, Li You was just sleeping in the room. At most, he was acting as a hero. A superior can get some credit and reduce some of his guilt.

Even so, he was not so shameless as to take Hei Fu's skills as his own, so he forced a smile and said: "This battle is all due to Hei Fu's proper command. If the four skills are combined, I am afraid that he can be upgraded to two levels in a row and directly become You’re a doctor!”

However, Hei Fu did not show his joy, but worshiped sincerely: "Why did the captain say this? The reason why we were able to defeat the Chu people in this battle was not only because the soldiers used their lives and worked together, could it be Didn’t it all depend on the captain’s plan in advance?”

"I... made a plan?" Li You blinked, but did not say anything. Instead, he looked at Heifu and asked him to continue.

Heifu smiled and said: "The captain was probably in a coma because he was too seriously injured and forgot some things."

"From sending me to pretend to surrender, to secretly telling me to go out of the city to attack the enemy, all the above are from the captain's mouth, and the subordinates are just following orders! Heifu has heard a saying, 'Those who work hard will rule the people. "Those who work hard govern others." In terms of merit, it is also the first contribution of Li Duwei, a hard worker! As a hard worker, subordinates are satisfied with a small amount of merit and a rank of nobility. How can they dare to be greedy and take great credit for themselves? Is there any?"
